p: Cardiff Road is one of the main streets leading into Caerphilly town centre, and from here you're only a few minutes' walk from the castle. Caerphilly Castle is the big one: a huge 13th-century fortress surrounded by lakes and moats. It's looked after by Cadw, and it's worth a couple of hours.

The town also gave its name to Caerphilly cheese, and there are plenty of cafés around the castle for a sit down afterwards. Caerphilly station has regular trains to Cardiff, so it's easy to get here without a car.
Lucky Strike is 18+, so it's one to leave the kids out of. Bring ID if you look young.
